name: Eway Payments for Woo
author: ewaypayments

sections.description:
Take payments through your Woo store with Eway

A secure Woo payment gateway for Australian and New Zealand businesses.

Accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay and Google Pay through a seamless on-site checkout, backed by local support and an Eway payment gateway and merchant account in one solution.

Talk to sales

Learn More

Why integrate WooCommerce with Eway?

Accept payments directly in Woo without redirecting customers to a third-party site. Offer cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and securely saved cards through a seamless on-site checkout experience designed to reduce purchase friction.

Robust and flexible

Process Visa, Mastercard, American Express and JCB cards, plus Apple Pay, Google Pay and securely saved payment methods through a single Woo integration.

The best protection

Built-in robust fraud prevention toolkit designed to protect your sales and your customers. Supports 3D Secure 2.0 to verify the cardholder at checkout. Level 1 Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliant to protect card data.

Faster checkout

Customers can choose to save their card details using tokenisation or pay faster with Apple Pay and Google Pay. By reducing the number of checkout steps, merchants can offer a smoother path to purchase and help reduce checkout friction.

More reasons to integrate

How to integrate Eway with WooCommerce

If you’re considering integrating Eway with WooCommerce, you can test prior to setting up a payments account via our Sandbox testing for developers. If you’re ready to integrate, please follow these steps:

  1. Create an Eway payments account – apply here
  2. Purchase the Eway gateway add-on plugin from Woo and upload to your site.
  3. Activate the extension through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate through the Woo section in your Admin panel to WooCommerce > Settings > Payment Gateways.
  5. Click Install module.
  6. Enter your Eway API Key and Password and select the card types your account can accept.

Visit WooCommerce

Take payments with another platform?

View our full list of integrations and add payments to your chosen website platform.

More than ecommerce

With little to no coding required, you can benefit from pre-built, off-the-shelf secure integrations with hundreds of business tools to help you grow. From accounting software, accounting software, to CRM systems, billing platforms, membership management tools, booking systems and event plugins Eway can help you confidently take charge of the management of your business.

Explore all integrations

Control and customisation

Choose your level of required customisation with multiple integration methods available with our flexible API. From outsourcing your business’ payment checkout and reduced PCI DSS obligations to sit within Eway’s infrastructure, to creating a custom look and feel for your payments solution – you choose your customers’ experience.

API Documentation

Benefits for all types of businesses

Eway is your easy to use, frictionless, online payments provider.

Fast setup

Same day setup for approved merchants. Eway easily integrates with your chosen platform.

Advanced cybersecurity

With all payments backed by our PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) Level 1 architecture, you and your customers get flexibility and visibility over transactions.

Simple pricing

Our friendly sales team is ready to provide you with a personalised solution aligned to your business needs.

Local support

Eway’s team is available during normal business hours for support and 24/7 for technical emergencies. We will provide you with everything you need to get started.

Fraud protection

Protect your sales and your customers. Get peace of mind with complimentary fraud protection included as part of your account which you can enable during setup.

Enable now

Tools for growth

250+ software integrations to support your business. Seamlessly integrate with accounting, billing, membership management, bookings, subscriptions, events and more.

Talk to sales

We’d love to help your business start taking online payments. Fill in your details below and someone from our team will be in touch as soon as possible.

Stop troubleshooting and start selling with Eway for WooCommerce

Eway takes the online payment puzzle off your plate so your store can keep moving. Get secure card payments, 1-3 day settlement, reliable integrations, scaling capability and local support from people who actually pick up the phone.

If you’re ready to make payments one less thing to worry about, fill in your details below and someone will be in touch as soon as possible.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Install and activate WooCommerce if you haven’t already done so
  4. For help setting up and configuring, please refer to our user guide
sections.faq:
How much does the Eway WooCommerce plugin cost?

The official Eway extension is free to install directly from the WooCommerce Marketplace. You won’t pay an upfront fee for the software itself. Instead, you only pay for what you use with Eway’s flat-rate pricing: 1.5% + 25c per transaction for domestic Visa and Mastercard. There are no monthly subscriptions or hidden gateway fees, making it a cost-effective, one-stop shop for businesses looking to keep overheads low while they scale.

Are there any setup fees or lock-in contracts for using Eway with WooCommerce?

No. We believe our service should earn your business every day, which is why we offer a transparent, pay-as-you-go model. There are no setup fees to get started and no restrictive lock-in contracts that prevent you from making the best decisions for your store. We give you the flexibility to grow at your own pace, supported by a reliable WooCommerce payment gateway Australia-wide.

Does Eway support Apple Pay and Google Pay in Woo?

Yes. Eway supports Apple Pay and Google Pay within Woo, allowing eligible customers to complete purchases using their preferred digital wallet. These payment methods can help streamline checkout by reducing the need to manually enter payment details. Availability depends on customer device, browser and payment account settings.

Does Eway support WooCommerce Subscriptions for recurring billing?

Yes. Eway is fully compatible with the WooCommerce Subscriptions extension to help you build predictable revenue. Our system works in the background, using secure tokenisation to handle recurring payments without forcing your customers to re-enter their details. It’s the ultimate “set and forget” solution for memberships or subscription models.

Can I process refunds directly from WooCommerce?

Yes. Eligible refunds can be processed directly through WooCommerce, helping simplify payment administration and customer service workflows.

Can I test the Eway WooCommerce integration before going live?

Absolutely. You shouldn’t have to “guess” if your checkout works. We provide a free Sandbox testing environment where you or your developer can run unlimited test transactions. This lets you verify that everything, from the customer UX to the Xero accounting sync, is flawless before you take a single real dollar.

How can I switch to Eway from another payment gateway without losing saved customer card details?

Moving shouldn’t mean starting from zero. As a PCI DSS Level 1 provider, Eway can facilitate a secure data migration of your existing customer tokens from platforms like Stripe or PayPal. This means your customers’ saved cards stay active, and your subscription billing continues without a hitch. Talk to our local, Australian-based support team, and we’ll see how we can make the transition frictionless.

Does Eway for WooCommerce support Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) options like Afterpay or Zip?

Eway lets you accept credit card payments in WooCommerce but does not process BNPL options like Afterpay or Zip directly. BNPL options can be added separately through their own WooCommerce plugins or payment gateways. That means you can offer Afterpay or Zip alongside Eway at checkout, so your customers have more ways to pay.

Can I accept payments in multiple currencies through WooCommerce with Eway?

Yes. Eway can support multiple currencies through WooCommerce, provided your Eway account and merchant facility are configured for each currency you want to process. For Australian merchants, this generally requires an internet merchant facility with NAB; for New Zealand, BNZ. Once configured, you can offer international customers a more localised checkout experience while using Eway to process eligible card payments in supported currencies.

What support is available if I have trouble setting up Eway on my WooCommerce store?

If you hit a snag, you won’t be stuck talking to a chatbot. You’ll have access to our local, Australian-based support team via phone or email during business hours. For critical issues, we provide 24/7 emergency technical support to ensure your store never misses a sale.
